messages:
emi: OK hear me out: Model Mascot Fashion Show this Friday. Each model gets a tiny costume + runway music. Winner gets a plushie. :tshirt::sparkles:

noah: 10/10. Categories: Best Debugging Jacket, Coziest KV-Cache Sweater, Most Likely to Softmax (tie-dye?).

tara: I volunteer as stylist for "Most Likely to Softmax". Also we should have a tiny runway code: `walk(); pose(); return logits;` :joy:

build-bot: build-bot: automatic reminder scheduled: Friday 16:00 #random "Model Mascot Fashion Show". CI lint: outfit-naming passed. :robot_face:

gus: gif idea: a tiny model in sunglasses that refuses to answer without coffee. :coffee: Can we make stickers?

emi: Sticker pack yes. Voting mechanism: react with :sparkles: for Best Debugging Jacket, :sweater: for Coziest KV-Cache Sweater, :sunny: for Most Likely to Softmax.

noah: Also theme rule: costumes must be made from recycled PR labels. Eco-fashion. :recycle:

tara: sample runway announcement: "Next up: Latte-13B wearing the gradient scarf of eternal context." crowd: :clap::clap:

build-bot: build-bot: note: please don't glue real GPUs to costumes. Facilities flagged previous incidents. :warning:

gus: I nominate Latte-13B for Best Debugging Jacket. The jacket has pockets for sticky notes. :stickers:

emi: tiny bonus: audience boos if a mascot hallucinate-lines during the show. We refund the applause. :laughing:

noah: logistics: bring tiny props, someone to man the camera, and a post-show poll. I'll make a simple Google poll and share.

tara: I'll craft runway music playlist: 'Token Walks' remixes. Also will design the plushie (winner gets a tiny context pillow).

build-bot: build-bot: pinned message updated: "Model Mascot Fashion Show Friday 16:00. Bring props, sweater donations accepted." :pushpin:

gus: closing ritual: practice walk in your chair now: `walk(); pose(); return logits;` :dancer: See you on the runway.
